resources.string: HyperDream
Experimental launcher animation duration, easing, and delay controls for LSPosed. HyperOS 4 compatibility unverified.
Your animations. Your flow. Your HyperOS.
Early development

The Animator tab targets standard Android setters. The Spring tab separately targets a guarded Java launcher spring-provider API. Neither can control native-only HyperOS transitions. No HyperOS 4 device has been verified.
Launcher setup

1. Install and enable HyperDream in LSPosed.

2. Select only the Xiaomi launcher (com.miui.home) in its scope.

3. Reboot your test device.

4. Check LSPosed logs for the HyperDream diagnostic message.

Beyond motion
Home Up-inspired direction, not feature parity. Everything below is planned and unavailable. There are no hidden working controls here.
Home screen · Planned
Grid and dock sizing, icon scale and labels, spacing, and free placement. Requires version-specific launcher research.
Folders · Planned
Folder grids, popup sizing, appearance, and opening motion. No folder hooks are installed.
Task switcher · Planned
Recents layouts, card sizing, labels, and switching behavior. May require components outside the current launcher-only scope.
Gestures · Planned
Home gesture behavior, swipe response, and navigation motion. System gesture ownership and safe hook points must be investigated.
Advanced animation · Planned
A guarded Java spring-provider adapter is now in the Spring tab. Native transition support, custom curve editing, genie effects, and per-app profiles remain unimplemented.
Layouts and sharing · Research needed
Layout backup and restore, DIY-style placement, and share-panel customization are research areas, not promised features. Feasibility depends on HyperOS internals.
Material You · wallpaper colors when available, with light and dark themes. Independent project. Not affiliated with Xiaomi or Samsung.

Native Runtime test

Experimental observer only. Install the separate HyperDream Native Runtime Probe ZIP through your root manager, then reboot. Requires arm64 HyperOS Runtime and Zygisk Next API v4 / HYOS API v1. It reports library loading; native animation duration, curves and springs are NOT patched yet. Disable the probe in your root manager to remove it.
Hook report

Generate a report to review, copy or share. Includes device/build versions, launcher library inspection and historical hook status. Root collection additionally reads only the HyperDream native log tag and probe module status. It does not restart anything, change settings or upload automatically. Logs may contain older builds. Native animation changes are not implemented in this test build.
